sets.title: Byte-identical invoice-totals function in three files
sets.description: A standalone invoice-totalling function is duplicated byte-for-byte across three files (top/middle/bottom positions), each surrounded by different helper functions. A near-miss margin summariser shares the vocabulary but computes a different result; a tax-rate repository is unrelated filler.
sets.notes: Byte-for-byte identical region in all three carriers; only the surrounding helper functions differ. Any detector class should recover all three members.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice vocabulary and foreach shape, but computes revenue/cost margins and a ratio — a different result
